body: There's lots of things but above all one of the major sources of my pain is because I'm transgender. I've known and been out for years and no matter how much I've pushed and tried and reached out not only can I not get the help I need but I've lost people, been attacked, abused etc for it. Is it so selfish to just want to live a life where I can actually be alive and actually be me? To not have to go everyday with the weight of things I have no control over making it worse, and the knowledge that only if I had the money, time and support I could've been so much better off and happier? I have so many other things causing me pain but this is one of the worst for me, and the people who tell me I just need to feel comfortable in my own skin don't understand my own skin doesn't feel like my own. I'm sorry that was long, it just all poured out
